text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
次の目的地は禁断の地かあ……
なんかすごそうな響きだよね。
text.official_en:
Our next destination is the forbidden land? Now
that sounds like an interesting place!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
そういえばダーリン、
折り入ってお願いがあるんだけど……
text.official_en:
In fact, I'm thinking a lot about where we've been,
where we're going, even where you're from...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
少しずつでもいいからさ、
あたいにフォドラのことを教えてほしいんだ。
text.official_en:
I want to hear about Fódlan. Not all at once, just
whatever comes to mind now and then.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
今まではそういうの、全然興味なかったんだけど、
前回の一件ですごく知りたくなったんだ。
text.official_en:
I never really thought too much about it, but after
what just happened, I want to know more.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ご先祖様やダーリンが生まれ育ったのが
どんな場所なのか。
text.official_en:
After all, you grew up there, Sweetie. And I guess I
descend from someone from Fódlan too.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そこにはどんな連中が住んでるのか、
どんな街があるかとか。
text.official_en:
What's it like there? The people, the cities... I want
you to tell me all about it.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
今回の目的地は、相当離れた場所となります。
期日までにたどり着けるよう考えると……
text.official_en:
Our next destination is quite remote. We must
consider the time required to traverse that distance.

text.jp: <#CTRL:0E>
text.official_en: I suggest we reach the nearby <#CTRL:0E>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
私の読み通りであれば、今回の調査で
天上人たちの正体に迫ることが出来るはずです。
text.official_en:
If it is as I have read, this investigation should let us
close in on the true identity of these celestials.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
砂漠の日差しについては……
考えようとしただけで憂鬱になりますがね……
text.official_en:
As regards the desert sun...the mere thought of it has
me despondent.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミカエラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
そういえばディートリヒ、
あんたはフォドラの貴族様なんだろう？
text.official_en: Dietrich, as I hear it, you're a noble back in Fódlan.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミカエラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
前々から気にはなっていたんだが、家の事を
ほったらかしたままで大丈夫なのかい？
text.official_en:
That being so, is it fine you've just up and left your
house and are wandering around Dagda?

text.jp: <NCA>問題ない
text.official_en: <NCA>Espouse confidence in Elfrida.

text.jp: <NCB>関係ない
text.official_en: <NCB>Suggest that it does not matter.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミカエラ
US EN person identifier agrees
post-choice branch reply retains the responder PID

text.jp:
<ACA>なるほど、家督を妹に譲って、家宝の
アンスウェラーだけ持って家を出たんだね。
text.official_en:
<ACA>Ah, your sister is taking care of things. So you just
strapped Answerer to your back and off you went.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミカエラ
US EN person identifier agrees
post-choice branch reply retains the responder PID
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
<ACB>……気を悪くしないでおくれ。
詮索するつもりはなかったんだ。
text.official_en:
<ACB>Sorry to pry. Hope you aren't annoyed by
the question.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミカエラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
まあ、あたしなんかが首を突っ込む
話じゃないだろうが、気になっちまうのさ。
text.official_en:
I know I shouldn't stick my nose in your business,
but I can't help being curious.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミカエラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
あたしも……自分の家のことで
色々と考えてしまうことがあってね。
text.official_en: Lately, family's been on my mind.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミカエラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
妙な話だけど……最近、あたしは
あんたのこと、他人とは思えなくてね。
text.official_en:
And I don't think of you as a stranger anymore, so
you have too.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミカエラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
あんただけじゃないさ。
エスメラルダも、ファビオも……
text.official_en: It's not just you. It's also Esme and Fabio.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
何やら君のクランの者たちの様子が
慌ただしいようだが、どこかに遠征かね？
text.official_en:
The people in your clan seem to be in quite a
hurry. Going on an expedition somewhere?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……なにしろ、君は目を離すと
何をするかわからない要注意人物だ。
text.official_en:
You must be closely monitored. If you escape my
attention, there's no telling what you could do.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
速やかに目的を果たして、
必ずここに戻ってきたまえ。――以上だ。
text.official_en:
Go about your business. Then return here. That is
all for now.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
噂に聞いたんだが、
海王ケートゥスが討伐されたらしいんだよ！
text.official_en:
Word around town is that someone took down Cetus,
the Sea Tyrant!
text.real_en:
Word around town is that someone took down Cetus,
the Sea King!

text.jp:
ぶったまげたなあ。いったい誰がそんな
とんでもないことを成し遂げたんだか……
text.official_en: Can you believe it? I can't. Who could even DO that?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
海王ケートゥスをやっつけたのって、
本当は黒いお兄ちゃんなんじゃないの！？
text.official_en:
You're the one who beat up Cetus! It was you, wasn't
it? You can tell me!

text.jp:
やっぱり、そうだったんだ！
ボクは最初から信じてたからね！
text.official_en: I knew it! I knew it had to be you!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
あ、あの……ケートゥスの噂、聞きました。
わたし、あなたがやったって思っています。
text.official_en:
I've heard about Cetus. As I expected, it was
your doing, wasn't it?

text.jp:
でも、わたし……あなたがこの街に
戻ってきてくれたことが、何よりも嬉しいです。
text.official_en:
I am...very relieved to see that you have made it back
to Dagsion safely.

text.jp:
はい、これ……
これからも、応援しています。
text.official_en:
Take this. Please know that I will keep cheering
for you.
